name: merge-delta-limits
body: Three limits. (1) A surviving target with no Struct/Function declarations installs no signatures or file_scopes entry (matching from_graph), never an empty-key entry. (2) merge_delta sorts overloads.scopes members while OverloadIndex::from_graph may not, so membership must be compared as sets. (3) The signature-inversion fallback covers Struct/Function FQNs; a delta edge whose far endpoint is a bare File FQN (a COBOL program-to-unchanged-copybook uses) has neither a delta node nor a signature entry and is skipped. Upgrade (3) only if the persisted index must carry copybook file-dependency edges across a delta scan, which needs a persisted File-identity set.
